# Notion: Competitor Analysis

Notion competes with Acme, Globex and Initech [1][2].

## Comparison table

| Company | Pricing | Core features | Market position |
|---|---|---|---|
| Notion | $10 per user per month | Docs, wikis and databases | Leader with broad adoption [1] |
| Acme | $12 per user per month | Docs and automation | Mid-market challenger [1] |
| Globex | Free tier, then $8 per user | Lightweight notes | 35% share among small teams [2] |
| Initech | Not publicly disclosed | Enterprise knowledge base | Niche enterprise player [2] |

## Key takeaways

1. Notion is priced below Acme [1].

2. Globex leads among small teams [2].

## References

[1] Acme pricing — https://acme.example/pricing

[2] Globex market share — https://globex.example/news/share
